stories.title: The Creation
stories.summary: God creates the heavens, the earth, and living creatures over six days. The account ends with God resting on the seventh day.

stories.title: The Fall of Man
stories.summary: The serpent persuades the woman to eat from the forbidden tree, and the man also eats. God confronts them, announces consequences, and sends them out of Eden.

stories.title: Cain and Abel
stories.summary: Cain kills his brother Abel. God confronts Cain and sends him away from the ground he cultivated.

stories.title: The Line of Seth
stories.summary: The genealogy traces the line from Adam through Seth to Noah. Enoch walks with God, and Noah is introduced with his three sons.

stories.title: Noah and the Flood
stories.summary: Noah builds an ark to preserve his household and animals through the flood. Afterward, God establishes a covenant with Noah and living creatures, with the rainbow as its sign.

stories.title: The Family of Noah
stories.summary: Noah’s sons and their descendants are named after the flood. The genealogy describes peoples, languages, and lands.

stories.title: The Tower of Babel
stories.summary: People build a city and tower to make a name for themselves and avoid being scattered. God confuses their language and scatters them across the earth.

stories.title: The Call of Abram
stories.summary: Abram’s family leaves Ur for Haran. God calls Abram to another land, and he travels to Canaan with Sarai and Lot.

stories.title: Abram and Lot
stories.summary: Abram and Lot separate their households. Lot settles near Sodom, and Abram later rescues him after a battle.

stories.title: Hagar and Ishmael
stories.summary: Sarai gives Hagar to Abram, and Hagar conceives. After fleeing mistreatment, Hagar encounters the angel of the Lord and returns; Ishmael is born.

stories.title: Abraham and Sarah’s Covenant
stories.summary: Abram and Sarai receive the names Abraham and Sarah. God promises a son named Isaac, and visitors announce his coming birth.

stories.title: Lot Leaves Sodom
stories.summary: Visitors warn Lot to leave Sodom with his family. The chapter recounts the cities’ destruction and the origins of Moab and Ben-ammi.

stories.title: Isaac and Ishmael
stories.summary: Sarah gives birth to Isaac. Hagar and Ishmael leave Abraham’s household, and God provides water for them in the wilderness.

stories.title: The Binding of Isaac
stories.summary: God tells Abraham to offer Isaac. A messenger stops Abraham, and a ram is offered in Isaac’s place.

stories.title: Isaac and Rebekah
stories.summary: Abraham’s servant travels to his master’s relatives to seek a wife for Isaac. Rebekah agrees to leave with him and marries Isaac.

stories.title: Jacob and Esau
stories.summary: Isaac and Rebekah’s sons grow up with different roles. Esau sells his birthright, Jacob receives Isaac’s blessing, and Jacob leaves for Paddan-aram.

stories.title: Jacob’s Household
stories.summary: Jacob reaches Laban’s household and marries Leah and Rachel. Their household grows through children born to Leah, Rachel, Bilhah, and Zilpah.

stories.title: Jacob Returns to Canaan
stories.summary: Jacob leaves Laban, wrestles through the night and receives the name Israel. He meets Esau and settles near Shechem.

stories.title: Dinah at Shechem
stories.summary: Shechem violates Dinah and seeks to marry her. Her brothers Simeon and Levi attack the city, and Jacob fears retaliation.

stories.title: The Death of Rachel
stories.summary: Jacob returns to Bethel. Rachel dies giving birth to Benjamin, and the chapter lists Jacob’s twelve sons and recounts Isaac’s death.

stories.title: Joseph and His Brothers
stories.summary: Joseph’s dreams and his father’s favour stir conflict with his brothers. They sell Joseph, and he is taken to Egypt.

stories.title: Judah and Tamar
stories.summary: Tamar seeks offspring after Judah fails to give her his son Shelah. Judah acknowledges her claim, and she gives birth to Perez and Zerah.

stories.title: Joseph in Egypt
stories.summary: Joseph serves in Egypt, is imprisoned, and interprets dreams. Pharaoh appoints him to store grain before a famine.

stories.title: Joseph Reunites His Family
stories.summary: Joseph’s brothers come to Egypt for food. Joseph reveals his identity, and Jacob’s household moves to Egypt.

stories.title: Jacob Blesses His Family
stories.summary: Jacob blesses Joseph’s sons and addresses his own sons before his death. The book closes with Joseph’s reconciliation with his brothers and his death in Egypt.
